kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستهبل (form X)
# أَسْتَهْبِلُ (ʔastahbilu) /ʔas.tah.bi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
# أَسْتَهْبِلَ (ʔastahbila) /ʔas.tah.bi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
# أَسْتَهْبِلْ (ʔastahbil) /ʔas.tah.bil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
